fixed.problem:
Blocking finding (OJ-06): the joined (closed) project still accepted new work, and so did its siblings.
- Its Tasks tab offered New task, under 'No tasks yet. Press New task, or describe them in Chat.'
- POST /projects/<kite>/tasks answered 201, and Changes promised 'It runs at your next Start.' No session ever runs on a joined project and the task's Undo is refused.
- Its Chat offered 'add a task: …' and Make this a task.
- Its Overview offered 'Note for the next session' and 'Research reads · Change'.
Root cause: only starts asked removedProjectRefusal. The command executor, POST /projects/:id/queue and the page's Tasks, Chat and Overview did not know a project could be closed into another.

fixed.how:
Executor:
- CommandExecutor.prepare calls refuseClosedProject(name, card) after the plan.
- A command whose card names a project closed into another, or a removed one (W15B-02's sibling), is refused with removedProjectRefusal's sentence: '"Kite club" joined "Site", so its work runs there.' / 'The project "X" was removed, so nothing of it runs.'
- Code validation, which the routes answer as 409 conflict, the same as the start's refusal. details.cause is project_joined or project_removed.
- This applies from the app, from chat and to a pending yes.
- OPEN_ON_A_CLOSED_PROJECT in join-words.ts is shared with the fake daemon. It keeps summary.speak, session.stop, session.pause, request.answer and project.join answering.

Route: POST /projects/:id/queue refuses a note for a closed project with the same sentence.

Sentences: joinedRefusalSentence, joinedTasksSentence and joinedChatSentence, all in join-words.ts.

UI:
- TasksTab (closed prop): no New task; with no task, 'Its tasks are in "Site".' with Open it.
- ChatTab (closed prop): the conversation is kept to read under 'This chat is kept to read; ask about its work in the Chat of "Site".' with Open it, which opens Site's Chat.
- Conversation readOnly: no message box, no examples, no Make this a task, no Yes/No, Undo, question options or Go ahead. An empty one reads 'Nothing was said here.'
- SummaryTab: no Research reads line and no note box for a closed project; no Decisions for a joined one, because they moved.
- A removed project gets the same treatment in its own words.

Fake daemon: refuses New task, a note and any command on a joined project, as the daemon does.
fixed.check_in_the_app:
Setup: two projects on one repository, then Make one project, keeping Site.
1. Open Kite club, Tasks tab. Expected: no New task button; 'Its tasks are in "Site".' with Open it, which opens Site's Tasks.
2. Kite club, Chat tab. Expected: 'This chat is kept to read; ask about its work in the Chat of "Site".' with Open it; no message box and no 'Try: add a task' line. Open it lands on Site's Chat with its message box.
3. Kite club, Overview. Expected: no Note for the next session, no Research reads Change, no Decisions; Last result and Your files still shown.
4. Through the API, POST /projects/<kite>/tasks and POST /projects/<kite>/queue. Expected: 409 '"Kite club" joined "Site", so its work runs there.'; settings.set for Kite club is refused with the same sentence.
5. Restart the app and repeat steps 1-4. Expected: the same.
6. Undo the join from Changes. Expected: Kite club has New task, its tasks and its chat box again, and takes a new task.

Bench evidence:
- /tmp/frbench/fixup-d1109-onerepo-join/steps/04-a-kite-joined-overview.png, 05-a-kite-joined-tasks.png, 06-a-kite-joined-chat.png, 07-a-site-chat.png
- After the daemon restart: 08 to 11 b-*.png; Undo from the Changes UI: 12 to 15.
- Checks: walk-a.json 13 of 14 and walk-b.json 15 of 15. The one failure in part a was the walk script's own count: the two queue items it saw were consumed brief and plan notes from before the join, not the probe note; part b's corrected check passes.

Live check for the session lead:
- In Kite club's Chat tab after a join there is no box to type in.
- In Talk opened on Kite club's page, say 'add a task: write the FAQ'. The real model must relay the refusal ('"Kite club" joined "Site", so its work runs there.'), not claim the task was added, and nothing is written.

not_done.why: No Postgres here (FORERUNNER_TEST_PG unset). A case nobody can run would be untested code. The join runs in one store.transaction through the repository methods both backends share.

not_done.problem: The joined page's Last result still says '"X" is ready to continue' about a task that now belongs to Site.
not_done.why: That sentence is built by d1109-sessions' summary text in views.ts, outside this area's regions. It is read-only text, not an action.

not_done.problem: GitHubHost.send's timeout also covers reading the response body: a slow body would throw a plain AbortError instead of the 'did not answer in time' error.
not_done.why: An edge case the reviewer named as non-blocking. Wrapping body reads in every GitHubHost method is a capabilities change of its own.

new_problems: Talk opened on a joined project's page (ConversationPanel uses the project on screen) still has its message box. A change asked there is refused in words by the executor's guard, but the panel itself does not say the chat is kept to read.
POST /projects/:id/plan (applyProjectPlan, no UI client method) still writes milestones and tasks on a closed project. It has no real-daemon case to extend, so it is not guarded here.

The Data tab's Add and Import still accept data on a joined project. The data routes have no store in their deps. Data assets start no work, but an import into the joined project is not seen by the kept one.

A chat change read back on a project before the join, and answered Yes after it, runs from its already-prepared steps without the new guard (the guard is in prepare). Rare: the join is not refused while a chat yes is pending.

The executor.ts re-indentation is limited to refuseClosedProject. Conversation.tsx's message box and examples moved one level in (wrapped in readOnly), which may cost a whitespace-only merge conflict with a later area that edits the chat composer.
notes_for_other_areas: packages/commands/src/executor.ts: CommandExecutor.prepare now calls refuseClosedProject(name, card) after the plan. It is a new private method, outside decideSteps and post, so d1109-selftasks-run's executor regions are untouched. Any command whose card.projectId is archived (joined or removed) is refused unless its name is in OPEN_ON_A_CLOSED_PROJECT.

@forerunner/runtime/daemon/join-words exports OPEN_ON_A_CLOSED_PROJECT (summary.speak, session.stop, session.pause, request.answer, project.join), joinedRefusalSentence(name, into), joinedTasksSentence(into) and joinedChatSentence(into). joinedProjectRefusal in commands' project.ts now builds its sentence with joinedRefusalSentence; the words are unchanged.
A later area that adds a command acting on a closed project must add it to OPEN_ON_A_CLOSED_PROJECT, or the executor refuses it in words. Example: task.split on a task of a joined project is refused.
POST /projects/:id/queue refuses a closed project (joined or removed) with ForerunnerError validation, which answers 409 conflict, before writing.

UI: TasksTab and ChatTab take a closed prop ({text, to}) from ProjectPage; Conversation takes readOnly; SummaryTab hides ResearchReads and QueueSection for a closed project and DecisionsSection for a joined one. Testids: chat-closed, no-tasks (with the closed text), chat-empty ('Nothing was said here.' when read-only).

Fake daemon: joinedRefusalOf(projectId) refuses POST /projects/:id/tasks, POST /projects/:id/queue and /commands/execute (except the open commands) for state.joined projects, with code validation for the command result.
project.join's undo restores the closed project's active flag from before.closed (it was always true before).

Suggested UPDATE-LOG line for U-091: 'A project that joined another takes no new work: its Tasks tab says where its tasks are, its Chat is kept to read, and a task, note or setting asked for it is answered "Kite club" joined "Site", so its work runs there.'
